from cachetools.tagged import TaggedCache

# The issue: MutableMapping.clear calls popitem() in a loop
# LRUCache.popitem calls self.pop(key) which calls __getitem__ then __delitem__
# But our TaggedCache.__delitem does clean up tags, so popitem should work

# Let's trace the issue more carefully
c = TaggedCache(3)
c.put('a', 1, ['x'])
print('After put: _Cache__data =', c._Cache__data)
print('After put: _tags =', c._tags)
print('After put: _expires =', c._expires)

# Now call LRUCache.popitem directly
from cachetools import LRUCache
print('popitem result:', LRUCache.popitem(c))
print('After popitem: _Cache__data =', c._Cache__data)
print('After popitem: _tags =', c._tags)
